verdict.rationale: Jules's API exposes a `requirePlanApproval` flag that, when left unset/false, lets the agent proceed without per-plan confirmation, and `automationMode` controls whether PRs are auto-created — together indicating a way to configure less human-in-the-loop gating. However, the default web-app flow explicitly requires reviewing and approving the plan and diff before changes are made, so 'auto-approve everything' is only achievable via the API, not as a simple toggle in the main product surface. Missing for 10: clear settings-level UI toggle for full auto-approval, documentation describing end-to-end unattended runs, and independent confirmation that API-configured sessions truly skip all human checkpoints.
